blocks.content: You now understand what GUI programming is and how Python supports it.
In the next lesson, we'll introduce your main portfolio project: your own version of the 2048 game, built with Tkinter.
It's a bigger challenge, but also a bigger reward. Let's take a look at what you'll be building.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
